notes.title: Chart Editor Announcement + Patch 1.1.1
notes.content: [h1][b]New Update![/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Release of Funk Engine:[/h2][p]The Midnight Riff chart editor has been released on Steam! Search for "Funk Engine" in your library, if it doesn't show up, make sure to search for "Tools" instead of just "Games".[/p][p][/p][p]With this you can make custom songs. Custom songs can be played from the main menu of Midnight Riff after completing the second stage. Once you save a chart, move the desired song to the "CustomSongs" in the user folder (this should be opened by default from the chart editor), Midnight Riff should now be able to load the custom song![/p][p][/p][p][b]For any help with this or tips for using Funk Engine, join the discord:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/JS3vRU89JZ"]https://discord.gg/JS3vRU89JZ[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][list][*][p]Custom songs can be charted and played back on beats rounded to 0.1. [i]This should have no impact on normal playthroughs.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]All custom songs will now loop properly. Previously, custom songs may sometimes pause after the first playback.[/p][/*][*][p]MacOS: The game file should now be correctly named.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your continued support![/h3]

notes.title: Midnight Riff Update Version 1.1 - Enemy Descriptions
notes.content:
[h1]New Update![/h1][p][/p][h2]Added Features:[/h2][p][/p][h3]- Enemy Descriptions:[/h3][p]Enemies with unique notes and/or mechanics now have descriptions explaining their effects.[/p][h3]- Performance Improvements:[/h3][p]Small performance tweaks should improve initial load times on lower end devices.[/p][h3]- Save File Overhaul[/h3][p]Save files have been overhauled, so there will be fewer incompatibilities between versions. However, old save files will not be compatible with the new version, we apologize if this causes any issues, read below.[/p][p][/p][h2]Important Note:[/h2][p]Due to changes behind the scenes, the save files have been updated. This means old saves will not carry over. [b]This will not affect overall game or Steam achievement progress! [/b][/p][p]This does not affect general settings, accessibility setting, or control preferences.[/p][p]Previously in-progress runs will not be able to be loaded. [/p][p]Some users may needs to recomplete the tutorial to continue as normal: Defeat the first tutorial enemy, then exit to the main menu to continue as normal. These users will also need to complete the area 2 boss fight again to unlock the custom songs button.[/p][h3]
Join our discord to join the community:[/h3][p][url="https://discord.gg/JS3vRU89JZ"]https://discord.gg/JS3vRU89JZ[/url] 
[/p][h3]Thank you for your continued support![/h3]

notes.title: Midnight Riff is a free new rhythm roguelike to vibe with
notes.content:
Another free game release for you. Midnight Riff is a rhythm roguelike where you have to jam with the music to deal damage and win battles.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/midnight-riff-is-a-free-new-rhythm-roguelike-to-vibe-with/
